DualMind Arena leaderboard methodology (bt-v1)

What a rating is
Every rating is fitted from real, blind votes with a Bradley-Terry model. A vote is one person picking
the better of two anonymous answers. For models i and j the model says i wins a decisive vote with
probability 1 / (1 + exp(-(s_i - s_j))). Ties count as half a win for each side. "Both bad" votes say
nothing about which model is better and are not used. A battle of a model against itself is dropped.

Scale
rating = 1000 + (400 / ln 10) * s, centred so the average of every model that has votes is 1000 (models with
few votes, and models since retired, are part of that average). A gap of 100 points means the
higher model wins about 64% of decisive votes.

Confidence intervals
Each model has a 95% interval from a bootstrap: the votes are resampled with replacement 400 times and the
model is refitted each time; ciLow and ciHigh are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the refitted ratings.
A wide interval means the votes do not yet separate the model from its neighbours.

Rank
rank is 1 plus the number of rated models on this board with a higher rating. rankLow is 1 plus the number of
rated models whose whole interval lies above this model's interval (the best rank still possible), and rankHigh is
1 plus the number of rated models whose interval reaches above this model's lower end (the worst). All three count
the same models, the rated ones listed here. A model gets rank, rankLow and rankHigh only with at least 30 countable
votes and an interval no wider than 150 points; below that it is listed by rating without a rank.

Which votes count
Votes from battles where the user chose both models (manual mode) are left out, as are votes under an integrity
flag that excludes them. When the votes exceed the read limit, the newest are used.

Few votes
A model with fewer than 5 countable votes is provisional. It keeps its seeded Elo (ratingSource "seeded"),
has no interval, no rank and no rating field (rating is null; eloScore still carries the seeded value for old clients,
on the seeded scale, which is not comparable with a fitted rating), and is listed after the rated models. As soon
as it has enough votes its rating comes from the votes only; the seeded value is never blended in.

Same input, same output
The fit is deterministic: the same votes give the same ratings and intervals. The board is rebuilt at most
every 5 minutes, so a new vote can take that long to show. While a rebuild runs, or the database is
unreachable, the last good board is served; if there is none, the endpoint answers 503 rather than an empty list.

Compatibility
Every field of /api/arena/model-stats is still present on each item (eloScore now holds the published
rating). The fields rating, ciLow, ciHigh, rank, rankLow, rankHigh, votes, provisional, ratingSource and degraded
are additions.
